name: Breaking Bad Habits
overview: Scripture teaches that breaking bad habits begins with honest confession and turning away from sin, as Proverbs 28:13 highlights the necessity of forsaking sin to receive mercy. True transformation requires presenting ourselves as living sacrifices to God and renewing our minds, as Romans 12:1-2 instructs, enabling us to discern and follow God's perfect will. Additionally, Ephesians 4:22 calls believers to actively put off their former corrupt ways, while Galatians 6:9 encourages perseverance in doing good, promising a harvest in due time. Ultimately, genuine obedience to Christ, rather than mere verbal profession, is essential for lasting change, as Luke 6:46 reminds us.
